editorial.blurb: A beloved local institution where a husband-and-wife team craft authentic Japanese teppanyaki dishes with genuine warmth and skill.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the fried pork rice—reviewers rave it tastes authentically Hong Kong-style, and arrive ready to eat fresh-off-the-griddle items immediately, as they come piping hot.
signatureDishes: Japanese fried pork chops and rice
